original: भगवानपि विश्वात्मा लोकानां हितकाम्यया । अवतीर्णो यदुकुले वसुदेवगृहे प्रभुः ॥

translation: The Supreme Lord, soul of the cosmos, desiring the welfare of all beings, incarnated in the Yadava clan in the home of Vasudeva.
meaning: Panchama Amsa — Divine Leela of Sri Krishna (Verse 5.1): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

translation: Reared in Gokula in the home of Nanda Maharaja, Sri Krishna vanquished Putana, the cart demon, and the whirlwind Trinavarta.

translation: He subdued the venomous serpent Kaliya, purifying the Yamuna waters to protect the cowherd community and gentle cattle.

translation: With supreme ease, Lord Hari lifted aloft Mount Govardhana upon a single finger for seven days to shelter His people from Indra's storm.

translation: In the autumn moonlight, Madhava enacted the celestial Rasa dance with the Gopis, revealing the nectar of supreme non-dual divine love.
meaning: Panchama Amsa — Divine Leela of Sri Krishna (Verse 5.7): Authentic classical exposition of Vaishnava philosophy.

transliteration: jaghāna kaṃsaṃ mathurāpure mallavarānapi | ugrasenaṃ mahīpālaṃ cakāra karuṇākaraḥ ||
translation: He slew the wicked Kamsa and his arena wrestlers in Mathura, restoring the righteous elder Ugrasena to the royal throne.

translation: On the battlefield of Kurukshetra, the Lord became the charioteer to Arjuna, imparting the nectar of the Bhagavad Gita to dispel all delusion.
